fields.System.Title: FDN-7 — Reference data
fields.System.Description:
Purpose

The small controlled lists that give every exception a name: why stock changed, who it came
from, and how this warehouse is configured.

Scope

In. Reason codes, partners (suppliers, customers, carriers), configuration values.

Out. Supplier contracts and terms. Carrier rate cards.

Design notes

Reason codes are the difference between correcting symptoms and finding causes. "Stock
changed by -3" tells you nothing. "Stock changed by -3, reason: damaged in handling" aggregated
over a month tells you which zone has a handling problem.

Keep the list short and specific. A list with forty codes gets used as "other" forty different
ways. Review it quarterly and merge the ones nobody picks.

Configuration lives in the database, not in environment variables, because a supervisor
changes over-receipt tolerance, not a deploy. Every change is audited.

Risks

| Risk | Reference |
|---|---|
| Reason codes too vague to analyse | [doc 05 WF 13](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
| Free-text reasons instead of a controlled list | [doc 03 §8](../../../docs/03-master-data.md) |
